relevance.rationale: Proves algebraic independence of modular/Eisenstein periods via differential Ramanujan systems combined with height and zero-multiplicity estimates; already cited in SurrealGradingPrune.lean.

keyResults.statement: For any q in (0,1), at least three of q, P(q), Q(q), R(q) are algebraically independent over Q, yielding algebraic independence of pi, e^{pi}, and Gamma(1/4).
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies the differential + height/multiplicity paradigm referenced by SurrealGradingPrune.lean and contrasted with formal-jet Wronskian descent in FigureEightPachnerAndJetTranscendence.lean.

proposedActions.rationale: Resolves prose reference in SurrealGradingPrune.lean and backs FigureEightPachnerAndJetTranscendence.lean.
